name: Barsbek (Germany)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Barsbek (a white fish on red).
history: Municipal flag of Barsbek; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Barsbek arms — white fish on red
